_id: feat rung: noTroposphere. One toggle against golden_baseline.json; everything else is inherited via _extends, so the difference in the result is attributable to this toggle alone. Troposphere OFF in truth and model.
_delta: Troposphere OFF in truth and model.
_pairNote: The truth/model pair is written out explicitly, not left to the master enable. resolveEnablePairsPostMerge only propagates a master into the pair when the pair is NOT in provenance.explicit, and every leaf of the _extends parent lands in that list -- so a child that writes only the master is a silent no-op against any parent that declares the pair. Same convention as config/realism.json.
_reportNote: compileTex 'auto' rather than the golden's 'require': a ladder rung's deliverable is its .mat, and a pdflatex hiccup must not throw away a finished 25-minute run. ReportRunner only escalates a failed compile to an error under 'require'.
